infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: EcoLens uses your camera to photo scan products and inspect their sustainability and packaging materials in real time.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EcoLens accesses your photo library to let you select product photos for AI sustainability analysis.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow EcoLens to access your camera to photo scan products and evaluate packaging sustainability.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow EcoLens to access your photo gallery to select product packaging images for sustainability audit.
